translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Rom
book.title: Rom Nalob̃ulat napisulan aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Rom

content: Nau nǝvanuan tile
Gidat dattodaŋ len nadǝlomian, len nǝ-daŋ-b̃uri-an datimasbulatut dan natideh b̃igol galit lǝsǝdaŋ len nadǝlomian lǝb̃igol nǝsaan. Sadatehusur naṽide togol gidat sǝb̃odat ŋai datohǝhaṽur.
Gidat ṽisusua datimashusur naṽide togol nǝvanuan tile b̃ehǝhaṽur lan, hǝn b̃evi tarhǝt san, hǝn nadǝlomian san b̃idaŋ am.
Husur aKristo sahusur naṽide gai sǝb̃on tohǝhaṽur lan, igol nǝsa aGot tolǝŋoni ŋai. Hum natosian siGot toke, “Na-sor-mǝdasi-an silat lotokele hǝn lǝb̃emǝdas gaiug, aGot, ibar ginau.”

Natit p̃isi len natosian siGot, lutosi sutuai hum nap̃usanan m̃os gidato hǝn datb̃ikad nǝ-vatvat-viri-an. Len nǝ-daŋ-b̃uri-an mai nasoruan siGot togol dattolǝŋon tovoi am len nǝlodato, datuvatvat vir natit p̃isi aGot tokel gati.
AGot tovi nǝkadun nǝ-daŋ-b̃uri-an togol dattolǝŋon tovoi am len nǝlodato, gai tigol mitikad nab̃onan mai gamit gabag, tinor hǝn nalǝŋonian seKristo, aYesu.
Timaienan hǝn mǝtb̃esua len nǝnauan mai nakelean, hǝn mǝtb̃isal suh nǝyalyalan siGot Tata mai aYesu Kristo, aMasta sidato.
Imagenan, hum aKristo tohǝhaṽur hǝn totah mai gamito, mǝtehǝhaṽur hǝn mǝtb̃itah mai gamit gabag, hǝn nǝvanuan gail leb̃isal suh nǝyalyalan siGot.

Husur nukel mai gamit ke, aKristo egǝm vi vanuan nauman seJu gail hǝn b̃imasil ke aGot ekitin. Na-kel-gati-an gail aGot tokel mai atǝmalit ta sutuai, aKristo egǝm hǝn b̃igol na-kel-gati-an galenan lǝb̃isarpoh.
Be egǝm m̃os natsual am. Egǝm hǝn alat lǝsavi Ju lǝb̃isal suh nǝyalyalan siGot husur nalolosaan san, hum natosian siGot toke,

content.text: len naluṽoh hǝn nǝvanuan naut tiltile gail.

content: Ikele am ke,

content.text: mǝtehǝhaṽur b̃onb̃on mai nǝvanuan san gail!”

content: Ikel tasi am ke,
Ale aIsaiah am ikele ke,

content.text: hǝn naluṽoh hǝn nǝvanuan naut tiltile gail
Dereh livatvat viri ke tigol nǝsa tokel gati.”

content: AGot tovi nǝkadun nǝ-vatvat-viri-an tigol nǝlomit tepul hǝn nakemkeman p̃isi mai natǝm̃at husur mǝttoriŋ nǝlomit lan. Hǝn ke, len nǝdaŋan seNunun aGot, dereh mǝtepul sǝsǝhov hǝn nǝ-vatvat-viri-an.
APol, ahai pispisul m̃os alat lǝsavi Ju
Bathudud sagw len nadǝlomian, ginau gabag nolǝboi sǝhoti ke, gamit mǝtopul hǝn navoian m̃os nǝvanuan, mǝtopul hǝn nalǝboian p̃isi ale mǝtolǝboi mǝtb̃eṽusan gamit gabag.
Ginau nǝsamǝmau hǝn nototos husur natgalevis van hǝn gamito hǝn nǝb̃eliv nǝnauan samit tǝlmam hǝn galenan. Nokǝmaiegai husur len navoian aGot toviol kǝmas hǝni,

novi nǝvanuan nauman seKristo, aYesu m̃os alat lǝsavi Ju. Nosum̃an ahai tutumav notokel na-kel-uri-an tovoi siGot, hǝn alat lǝsavi Ju lǝb̃egǝm vi naviolan hǝn natutumavan aGot b̃ehǝhaṽur hǝni, aNunun aGot togol ke naviolan enan evi siGot sǝb̃on ŋai.
Imaienan, len nauman p̃isi sagw m̃os aGot, noṽiv husur evi aKristo aYesu ŋai togole.
Asike nusor husur natideh am, be nukel nǝsa ŋai aKristo togole nǝboŋ notoum san. Len nǝsa notokele mai nǝsa notogole, aKristo esǝhar alat lǝsavi Ju hǝn lǝb̃igol husur nǝsa aGot tokele.

Loriŋ nǝlolit lan bathut namerikel gail lotomaŋmaŋ lan, namerikel gail notogole len nǝdaŋan seNunun aGot. Imaienan, ginau nukel p̃is na-kel-uri-an tovoi seKristo, tub̃at len naut a Jerusalem van van van vǝbar naut a Ilirikum.

Nǝboŋ nototub̃at len nauman egai van vǝbar damǝŋai, nolǝŋon masuṽ hǝn nǝb̃ikel ur na-kel-uri-an tovoi len naut lǝsalǝboi aKristo lan boŋ ideh. Nǝsalǝŋon nǝb̃ikel uri len naut ideh nǝvanuan tile tokel uri lan tia.
Be hum natosian siGot tokele husur aKristo, ike,

content.text: “Alat, avan ideh sakel ur atenan mai galito,

content: Nauman sagw len naut tiltile gail ipatpat gol ginau hǝn asike nǝb̃egǝm ris gamito.
APol ike tevi Rom
Be gagai nunoŋ len nauman sagw len naut galegai, ale naut kǝmas nasihau tosob̃ur lotovan, nolǝŋon masuṽ hǝni sal ke negǝm ris gamito.
Nunau utaut hǝn nǝb̃evi Spen, ale len nǝyaran sagw vǝna, nuke neris gamit a Rom. Nǝboŋ nǝb̃itoh kǝkereh b̃inoŋ len nahǝhaṽuran samito, nuke mǝtevi tarhǝt sagw len nap̃isal van.
Be nevi Jerusalem bai hǝn nǝb̃evi tarhǝt silat lotovi siGot ei.
Husur alat siYesu a Masetonia mai a Akaia lohǝhaṽur hǝn lotobubulah vat m̃os alat lotovi mǝsal len nǝvanuan siGot gail a Jerusalem.

Lohǝhaṽur hǝn lotomaienan husur lunau ke lotokabut seJu gail. Husur alat lǝsavi Ju, lǝb̃ihan katǝp̃ol mai naJu siGot gail len nǝmauran aNunun aGot toviol hǝni, inor hǝn lǝb̃evi tarhǝt salito len natit lotokade.
Ŋa nǝboŋ nǝb̃itariv nǝvat egai mai galito, nǝboŋ nǝb̃igol nauman eg b̃inoŋ, dereh niyar tur len naut a Rom vi Spen.
Nolǝboii ke nǝboŋ nǝb̃ibar naut samito, aKristo dereh teviol hǝn navoian kavkav mai gidato.

Bathudud nadǝlomian, husur dattoriŋ nǝlodat len aMasta sidato, aYesu Kristo, mai husur aNunun aGot togol datolǝmas bun gidat gabag, nous idaŋ ke, mitib̃on mai ginau len nǝb̃alan sagw len na-sor-tuṽ-an samito m̃os ginau van hǝn aGot.
Mitisor tuṽ hǝn aGot b̃ilav kuv ginau dan navǝlan alat a Jutea lotomǝtahun lǝb̃igol husur nǝsa aGot tokele. Sor tuṽ hǝn alat siGot len naut a Jerusalem lǝb̃ehǝhaṽur hǝn nǝvat nǝb̃ilav mai galito.
Beti, aGot b̃elǝŋoni, dereh negǝm hǝn gamito len nakemkeman, hǝn nǝnauan sagw b̃imaur tǝlmam len natohan sagw mai gamito.
Ale aGot tovi nǝkadun natǝm̃at, titah tin mai gamito! Ganan.

footnotes.text: 15.20 Len nasoruan ta Kris ike, nǝsalǝŋon nǝb̃eum hǝn naim len nǝpaudesen sinǝvanuan tile.
